Docs.summary: Represents the platform-specific application instance that hosts a .NET MAUI application.
Docs.remarks: This interface provides access to platform-specific services and the main application instance. Each platform (Android, iOS, Windows, etc.) provides its own implementation of this interface. Use the IPlatformApplication.Current property to access the current platform application instance.

Docs.remarks: This property provides access to the main MAUI application instance, which contains application-level configuration, the main page, and application lifecycle methods. Use this to access application-wide properties and methods.

Docs.summary: Gets or sets the current platform application instance.

remarks.para: This property provides access to the platform-specific application instance and its services. It must be manually set by each platform implementation during application startup.

remarks.para: Always check for before using this property, especially during application startup or in unit tests where the platform application may not be initialized.

Docs.summary: Gets the dependency injection service provider for the platform application.
Docs.value: An instance containing platform-specific and application services.
Docs.remarks: Use this service provider to resolve services that have been registered with the platform's dependency injection container. This includes both framework services and custom services registered during application configuration.
